title: Tornado Aftermath Package
description:
Package about how 305 Tornadoes in 24 hours devastated cities across five states. Tornadoes left a path of destruction in Miss., La., Ga., Tenn. and the hardest hit, Alabama.  The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is on site helping tornado victims.  Mary Cochran takes us to a neighborhood hard hit.  Sound bites include Boyce Thornton - Tuscaloosa Resident, Col. John Pilot - Commander, USACE Recovery Field Office, Terry Sharpless - Debris Removal Resident Engineer, USACE and John Kucharski - Temporary Housing Mission Manager, USACE.  Produced by Mary Cochran. 

mary.cochran@afn.dma.mil
